emma_cs: Quick check-in: Exchange Accelerator private deploy — day 1. Where are we on networking, IAM, KMS, and audit logs? Any immediate blockers from infra/security? cc @ryan_sre @lucas_se @olivia_security :wave:
ryan_sre: Network CIDR they provided is 10.10.0.0/16 — that's overlapping our transit CIDR in eu-west. Need them to pick a different /16. @emma_cs can you confirm if they're willing to switch?
emma_cs: Asked them; they can move to 10.240.0.0/16. I'll update the runbook and the preflight checklist.
lucas_se: IAM plan: they want a single cross-account role with an ExternalId. Draft trust policy posted in runbook. Example trust block:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"sts:ExternalId":"exchange-2026"}}}]
}
```
olivia_security: Quick skim — looks good. Two items: (1) enforce MFA for any human admin console access, (2) KMS key policy needs explicit key usage constraints + a 90-day rotation note. I'll paste suggested KMS snippet in a sec.
olivia_security: KMS recommended create command (example):
```bash
aws kms create-key --description "Exchange Accelerator rdw-key" --policy file://exchange-kms-policy.json --origin AWS_KMS
```
Make sure policy includes "kms:GenerateDataKey" only for service principals we approve.
emma_cs: Audit logs: Exchange wants Splunk forwarding from a private S3 bucket. Need to verify bucket ownership, SSE settings, and ACLs. @audit-bot can you confirm our recommended S3 bucket policy for audit delivery?
audit-bot: Recommended S3 config: [bucket-owner-full-control], BlockPublicAccess = true, ServerSideEncryption = AES256 or KMS (provide key ARN), enforce bucket-owner-enforced ACLs, and delivery role with s3:PutObject and s3:PutObjectAcl. See docs: https://redwood.docs/onboard/s3-audit-forwarding.
ryan_sre: Egress plan — they need NAT for outbound OS/agent updates. We'll provision NAT Gateway in the public subnet and update private route tables accordingly. Also enabling VPC Flow Logs to the central logging account is required for audit; I'll include that in the PR.
emma_cs: Risk note: Customer CTO tied part of renewal to go-live SLA. If network provisioning slips more than 5 business days, flag renewal as high risk. Marking this in the account health tracker :warning:
lucas_se: Action items (quick):
1) olivia_security — sign off final KMS policy (assigned)
2) ryan_sre — open infra PR for route tables/NAT + flow logs (assigned)
3) emma_cs — confirm S3 encryption + ownership model with customer and share acl example (assigned)
I'll add these to the onboarding runbook and tag owners.
emma_cs: ETA target to close these inbound items: 48 hours. I'll escalate if any blocker pops up.
ryan_sre: Starting infra PR now, will link when ready: https://github.com/redwood/infracluster/pull/1427 :rocket:
olivia_security: Signed off on the KMS policy in the PR, left two inline comments regarding least-priv permissions. :white_check_mark:
emma_cs: Great, thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for day-1 blockers. I'll post any customer replies here.
